en: Black‑and‑white view of a corner building on a cobblestone street, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century. The three‑storey structure has ornate neoclassical decoration, a mansard‑like roof with small chimneys and finials, and many regularly spaced windows. A wrought‑iron balcony at the corner is crowded with people posing for the camera, and there are shopfronts at street level with signage in a Germanic-looking script. Women in long dresses and hats walk along the sidewalks, and there are tram or trolley wires overhead, suggesting an urban European setting.
